description: CORS preflight for POST /content/entities/active. Must short-circuit to 204; Allow-Methods lists the actual methods the server accepts including OPTIONS for preflight.
captured_from: INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE from upstream — allow-headers are REFLECTED from Access-Control-Request-Headers (the nginx _cors.inc behavior the transparent front used to provide): auth chains are open-ended (X-Identity-Auth-Chain-N grows with delegation/EIP-1654 links), so any enumerated list is a ceiling that breaks signed login. Decision 2026-07-31, transparent-front cutover gate. Golden asserts OUR (post-reflect) headers.
